h1b: tell a robot what to do in plain words
lead: This is how an AI layer on top of an existing robot works. You type an order. It becomes a plan in the robot's own language. The plan is checked against safety rules. The robot only moves after a human presses Approve.
block: Drop a box in its way
w1p: English, Dutch or French. No code, no robot training.
w2p: In the commands the robot already understands. It never touches the motors itself.
w3p: No-go zones, speed limit, payload, battery. Unsafe orders are refused.
w4p: The robot's own safety system stays in charge. The E-stop always wins.
honest: Honest note: in this free demo, simple rules turn your words into the plan, so it works without any account or AI key. In a real project an AI model writes the plan, and the same checks and the same approve button stay in place.
ctaP: Do you run robots or sell them? We build this kind of layer for existing robots: a help bot for your technicians, plain-language orders, and a daily fleet report.
fNote: Simulation only. It does not control any real machine.
